findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization via pickle or marshal
 * @description Detects usage of pickle or marshal which can lead to arbitrary code execution if used on untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential unsafe deserialization."
findings.hypothesis: Jinja2 might use pickle or marshal for bytecode caching. If this deserialization is performed on untrusted data or files that can be manipulated by an attacker, it poses a security risk.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection from user input
 * @description Using compile, eval, or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CodeInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(CodeExecution ce).getCode()
  }
}

module CodeInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CodeInjectionConfig>;
import CodeInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CodeInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Code injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Code injection via compile/eval/exec from remote sources
Path traversal in template loaders allowing access to arbitrary files.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Improper neutralization of input during web page generation (XSS)
 * @description Using Markup() on untrusted data can lead to XSS
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2/xss-markup
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module XssMarkupConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("markupsafe").getMember("Markup").getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module XssMarkupFlow = TaintTracking::Global<XssMarkupConfig>;
import XssMarkupFlow::PathGraph

from XssMarkupFlow::PathNode source, XssMarkupFlow::PathNode sink
where XssMarkupFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential XSS via Markup() from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Using Markup() on untrusted data bypasses autoescaping and can lead to XSS.
